New in this update:
• Assignments: add homework and see what's overdue, due today or coming up
• Due dates are set for you: pick the day it was assigned, and it's due 7 days later at the end of that day (change the length in Settings → Assignments, or give one its own deadline)
• Each assignment shows how many days you have left
• Tick it when you hand it in, and it records whether you were on time or late, and by how much
• Reminders at 6 PM the day before, 9 AM on the due day and an hour before
• An Assignments card on Home and on each subject page; assignments are included in backups
